historical_territory: Các thực hành ghi nhận và xác thực bằng đất sét trong Late Uruk, đặc biệt sự dịch chuyển toward việc đặt thông tin số trực tiếp trên bề mặt bền trong khi nhiều phương tiện cũ vẫn cùng tồn tại.

historical_change.from: Số lượng và sự xác thực được xử lý qua nhiều thiết bị và thực hành đất sét cùng tồn tại, gồm counters, envelopes, sealings và các bề mặt ghi số.
historical_change.to: Thực hành ghi nhận ngày càng đặt thông tin số trực tiếp trên bề mặt đất sét bền, đôi khi cùng dấu xác thực, trong khi các phương tiện cũ vẫn tiếp tục chồng lấn.

world.operation: record and authenticate administrative information through several coexisting clay-based practices

primitives.time_scope: Late Uruk, especially the late fourth millennium BCE
primitives.place_scope: Southern Mesopotamia and associated Late-Uruk administrative contexts

carries: on some examples exterior impressions or sealings
constrains: enclosed counters are not directly inspectable while the envelope remains closed

primitives.place_scope: Late-Uruk administrative contexts represented in the approved source set

permits: place quantity information directly on a durable exterior surface
carries: on some examples sealing or authentication marks

primitives.place_scope: Southern Mesopotamia and related Late-Uruk administrative sites in the approved source set

world.dimension: physical placement and inspectability of numerical information
world.earlier_state: quantities and authentication were handled across several coexisting physical devices and clay practices
world.later_state: numerical information increasingly appeared directly on durable clay surfaces, sometimes alongside authentication marks
world.coexistence: older and parallel clay practices continued to overlap with direct surface recording
world.qualification: the shift does not identify one invention event or an immediate complete replacement

primitives.time_scope: Late Uruk, late fourth millennium BCE
primitives.place_scope: Southern Mesopotamia and related Late-Uruk administrative contexts

boundaries.rule: Parallel practices must not be converted into a single mandatory developmental sequence.
Exterior impressions are not universal to every envelope.
The affordance does not establish a single transitional step toward tablets.
A numerical tablet alone does not identify a commodity, transaction mechanism or named actor.
Direct surface recording must not be described as wholesale replacement of envelopes or tokens.
Increasing direct surface recording does not imply immediate or complete replacement of other clay practices.
Do not convert overlapping clay practices into a direct token-to-tablet replacement genealogy.
Do not label a specific economic mechanism such as market exchange, tax, tribute, redistribution, labor obligation or ownership unless independent transaction evidence supports it.

writer_contract: Historical Substrate is the primary model of historical reality. Evidence lookup is secondary and only verifies, sharpens or qualifies details needed by a telling already chosen from this model.
